What VoatWraith said. You get waht you pay for. On that note if you are looking to go that low on price I'd do the AK.

Keep looking. If you're on a budget, check 2 sites:

https://www.slickguns.com/category/rifles?caliber=11

But factor in shipping and FFL transfer fees ($25~35 for me, I've seen some people claim they pay north of $100).

http://www.armslist.com/

Which is about the best local shopping site I've found. Lots and LOTS of way overpriced stuff, but occasionally you'll find a deal. I paid about $200 under new price for my last firearm, came with a few extras too.

The last thing you can do is shop used Parts to assemble yourself. Only the lower (for an AR, I've been nothing but disappointed in AKs) requires an FFL or local purchase. If you go That route, then there are several big AR15 sites with active classifieds where you can get some screaming deals.

If there's something you like, and can afford, just buy it and stop fretting.
